description: List catalog products with optional name/sku/visibility filters and paging.

name.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against product names.

is_visible.description: Optional visibility flag to filter products by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of products and 'meta' pagination.

description: Get a single catalog product by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the product 'data'; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List orders with optional customer/status filters and paging.

customer_id.description: Optional customer id to filter orders by.

status_id.description: Optional status id to filter orders by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of order objects.

description: Get a single order by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the order object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new order, computing totals from the supplied product lines.

customer_id.description: The customer id for the order (default 0).

products.description: Optional list of product lines (product_id, quantity, price_inc_tax) used to compute the total.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created order object.

description: List customers with optional email/company filters and paging.

email.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against customer emails.

company.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against customer companies.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'data' list of customers and 'meta' pagination.
